provenance_note: Run predates the provenance capture in run.py; fields reconstructed from the session record, not captured at run time.

weights.caveat: same lineage as torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 but not verified bit-identical to it
weights.conversion: from Keras/caffe HDF5 (storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/keras-applications/vgg19/vgg19_weights_tf_dim_ordering_tf_kernels.h5): kernels (kh,kw,in,out)->(out,in,kh,kw); conv1 input channels BGR->RGB; fc1 flatten reordered (H,W,C)->(C,H,W); caffe preprocessing folded into conv1 so the net takes the repo's normalised RGB input
weights.source: Oxford VGG-19 ImageNet weights, converted to torchvision layout

validation.note: all top-5 dog breeds; a layout or channel error yields garbage
